near_header: pix u16 | n u16 | ox oy oz f16 | sx sy sz f16. Codec id, version, bit widths, mag0, and mag_scale live in tiles/manifest.json.
origin_policy: r=0 maps to theta=0, phi=0 (Sol has no direction)
quant_xyz: origin = nearest f16 of the tile minimum; scale = smallest f16 >= (max - origin) so the far edge quantizes to 4095 or less. Quantize against those f16 values, not the f64 box.
quant_mag: (mag - mag0) / mag_scale * 255. mag0 and mag_scale are catalog-global and identical for every tile; both are stored once in manifest.json.
morton: 12-bit xyz interleave, x at bit 3i, y at 3i+1, z at 3i+2; equal codes break by row_id

lod.frame: orbit distance at which the catalog bounding sphere fills the vertical field of view
